neet_phy_u15_t03_1.working: Frequency increases from microwaves to infrared to ultraviolet to X-rays.

neet_phy_u15_t03_2.working: λ = c/ν = 3e8/1.5e18 = 2e-10 m = 0.2 nm, which lies in the X-ray region.

neet_phy_u15_t03_3.working: Microwaves are produced by special vacuum tubes such as the klystron and magnetron, and by the Gunn diode.

neet_phy_u15_t03_4.working: Radio waves come from accelerated charges in circuits (IV). Infrared comes from hot bodies and molecular vibrations (II). X-rays come from electron bombardment of a metal target (III). Gamma rays come from nuclear decay (I).

neet_phy_u15_t03_5.working: A, B and C are true. D is false because all EM waves travel at c in vacuum. E is false because point-contact diodes detect microwaves; infrared is detected by thermopiles and bolometers.
